query: Terrion Arnold Detroit Lions Commissioner's Exempt List released waived NFL transaction status July 2026
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the key finding:

**Terrion Arnold was NOT placed on the Commissioner's Exempt List.** Instead, the Detroit Lions **released/waived him on June 29, 2026** (hours after a Florida judge set his $1M bond on eight felony charges), and he **cleared waivers unclaimed on July 6, 2026**, becoming an unrestricted free agent.

The Commissioner's Exempt List mechanism didn't apply because it only covers players on an NFL roster — the Lions cut him outright first. As of mid-July 2026, he remained unsigned but had worked out for the Texans and drawn interest from several teams (Colts, Jets, Seahawks reported). A judge also ruled he wouldn't need a GPS ankle monitor while on bond, allowing him to visit teams. The full report with timeline, sources, and data points has been submitted via the structured output.
